name: Alam Halfa: 30 August–6 September 1942 (linked research)

aim.cw: Hold Alam Halfa, El Alamein and Alexandria while breaking the Axis southern thrust with supply, artillery and mobile reserves.
aim.axis: Turn the southern Alamein flank through Alam Halfa and force a way toward Alexandria before fuel runs short.

about: Linked daily trial for the historical 30 August attack and early September withdrawal. The Australian War Memorial dates the attack and notes fuel shortages and air attacks. The played force may attack or defend elsewhere; no fuel tanker loss, withdrawal or fixed battle result is scripted. The current map cannot represent all ridge positions and minefields precisely.
